description: This file contains the code-behind for the ExamResult page in an online examination system, handling the display and updating of user's exam results, as well as session management and navigation events.

classes.name: OnlineExamSystem.ExamResult
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ExamResult.aspx page, managing user session data, database updates, and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page initialization, updates user exam statistics in the database, and populates result display fields from session variables.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the UserProfile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles user logout and navigation to the LoginPage.
